item.title: Spider-Gazelle Web Framework Update (MCP)
item.author: stakach
item.content:encoded: New spider-gazelle web framework update now adds MCP support for simplified AI tool integrations.You don’t need to double handle coding an MCP server for your service anymore, they are one and the same.It also supports cool features like MCP Apps (we call these cards) and this is an example of one we built for our workplace productNot only is this a boon for our clients, I have now been delegating data entry tasks to AI which can use the MCP connectors to much more effectively take tedious work off my plate.

item.title: Crystal 1.22.1 is released!
item.author: Crys
item.content:encoded: We are announcing a new Crystal release 1.22.1 with important security patches and regression fixes, as well as some regular bug fixes.
